In the field of regional development and real estate, TIDH Holding plays main force and vanguard roles in core urban area and the municipal key projects.

TIDH Holding has undertaken the supply of water, power, gas, heat and other energies, as well as construction and operations of infrastructure such as mass transit and urban greening.

TIDH Holding has one of the largest oil casing pipe production base, our efficiency has been improved significantly over last few years.

We became in short time Oriental Investment Platform in the Heart of Middle East, lot of partners were called to join, and well-balanced synergy was created between partners.
TIDH Investment – Abu Dhabi a door to the Middle East for Chinese investments and warm welcome to Far East to Arabian investors. Promoting friendship and intercultural respect and support, in all these years, which has resulted in many ways and helped draw together Chinese and Arabian business interest under one roof.

TIDH offers a wide range of investment fields, If you have specific plans to do business abroad,  TIDH  helps you find reliable foreign partners and projects quickly. We aim to grow into a world-class and respected Investment Company in Middle East.
